map.木材干燥质量评估：称取湿重与绝干重，算出含水率并判断处于窑干/气干/半干/湿材/: Assessing drying quality: weigh the wet sample and the oven-dry sample, compute the moisture content and judge whether it falls in the kiln-dried, air-dried, half-dried, wet or green range, to decide whether it can be used indoors.
map.加工前选材：室内家具通常要求 8–12% 含水率，超出则需继续干燥以防后期开裂变: Selecting stock before machining: indoor furniture usually requires 8–12% moisture content; above that, drying must continue to prevent later cracking and distortion.
map.干燥收缩预测：从纤维饱和点(30%)到当前含水率的径向、弦向、体积收缩率，预估拼: Predicting drying shrinkage: the radial, tangential and volumetric shrinkage from the fibre saturation point (30%) to the current moisture content, to estimate dimensional change after panel gluing and mortising.
map.示例：橡木试样 湿重120g / 绝干重100g: Example: oak sample, wet weight 120 g / oven-dry weight 100 g
map.含水率 = (120 − 100) ÷ 100 × 100 = 20.0%，属「: Moisture content = (120 − 100) ÷ 100 × 100 = 20.0%, i.e. "wet" (further drying recommended). The gap from the fibre saturation point of 30% to 20% is 10 percentage points: radial shrinkage about 1.70%, tangential about 3.60% and volumetric about 5.20% (oak coefficients radial 5.1 / tangential 10.8 / volumetric 15.6, all computed as ÷ 30 × difference).
map.含水率多少算适合做家具？: What moisture content is suitable for furniture?
map.室内木制品一般要求 8–12%（气干范围）。低于 8% 为窑干，适合精密木工；高: Indoor woodwork generally requires 8–12% (the air-dried range). Below 8% is kiln-dried and suits precision woodworking; above 12% the stock must be dried further before indoor use, otherwise it cracks and warps easily.
map.纤维饱和点 30% 是什么？: What is the fibre saturation point of 30%?
map.纤维饱和点（FSP）是细胞壁吸饱水、胞腔游离水已排尽的临界点，约 30%。低于此: The fibre saturation point (FSP) is the critical point at which the cell walls are saturated with water while the free water in the cell cavities has drained, about 30%. Only below this point does wood begin to shrink significantly; shrinkage is estimated as "(30% − current moisture content) ÷ 30 × species coefficient".
map.径向和弦向收缩为什么不一样？: Why do radial and tangential shrinkage differ?
map.木材弦向收缩约为径向的 1.5–2 倍，源于射髓细胞与纹理方向差异。因此宽板易瓦: Tangential shrinkage is about 1.5–2 times the radial value, owing to differences in ray cells and grain direction. Wide boards therefore cup easily and glued panels open up at the joints, so allow extra stock and stress relief when cutting.
map.含水率 = (湿重 − 绝干重) ÷ 绝干重 × 100%: Moisture content = (wet weight − oven-dry weight) ÷ oven-dry weight × 100%
map.状态分档：≤8% 窑干｜≤12% 气干｜≤18% 半干｜≤25% 湿材｜其他 生: Condition bands: ≤8% kiln dried | ≤12% air dried | ≤18% semi-dry | ≤25% damp | otherwise green
map.干缩基准：纤维饱和点 FSP = 30%: Shrinkage baseline: fiber saturation point FSP = 30%
map.从 FSP 至当前含水率的收缩幅度 = 30% − 当前含水率: Shrinkage span from FSP to the current moisture content = 30% − current moisture content
map.径向收缩率 = 树种径向全收缩率 ÷ 30 × 收缩幅度: Radial shrinkage = species radial total shrinkage ÷ 30 × shrinkage span
map.弦向收缩率、体积收缩率同理: Tangential and volumetric shrinkage follow the same method
map.每 100cm 尺寸收缩量 = 收缩率 cm: Shrinkage per 100 cm = shrinkage in cm
map.含水率标尺 0~35% 映射标记位置 = mc/35 × 100%: The 0–35% moisture gauge maps the marker position as mc/35 × 100%
map.室内用材标准 8%~12%，>12% 需继续干燥: Indoor timber should be 8%–12%; above 12% needs further drying

map.含水率 W = (湿重−绝干重) ÷ 绝干重 × 100%。表中区间只描述含水率: W = (wet − oven-dry) ÷ oven-dry × 100%. The bands describe moisture state only and cannot prove the drying method (kiln or air); equilibrium moisture varies with climate, season and use.
map.木材干燥状态判断：称取湿重与绝干重，算出含水率，并按区间描述为很低（近绝干）、室: Assess drying state: weigh wet and oven-dry samples, calculate moisture content, and describe it as very low, common indoor, above indoor, wet or green; the reading alone does not prove kiln or air drying.
map.加工前选材：把结果与当地平衡含水率、用途和干燥记录一起核对；室内家具常见目标区间: Select stock before machining: check the result against local equilibrium moisture, end use and drying records. Indoor furniture commonly targets about 6–12%, adjusted for local climate and use.
map.干燥收缩预测：以可调的纤维饱和点（默认 30%，范围 20–40%）和树种系数估: Shrinkage estimate: use an adjustable FSP (default 30%, range 20–40%) and species coefficients to estimate current shrinkage; with a target moisture content it also gives the further shrinkage from current to target.
map.示例：橡木试样 湿重120g / 绝干重100g / 目标8% / FSP 30: Example: oak sample, wet 120 g / oven-dry 100 g / target 8% / FSP 30%
map.含水率 = (120 − 100) ÷ 100 × 100 = 20.00%，属: Moisture content = (120 − 100) ÷ 100 × 100 = 20.00%, which is wet stock, not the common indoor range. Drying from FSP 30% to 20%: radial about 1.70%, tangential about 3.60%, volumetric about 5.20%. Drying on to 8%: radial about 3.74%, tangential about 7.92%; relative to the current state this adds about 2.04% radial and 4.32% tangential shrinkage.
map.多数室内木制品常见目标约 6–12%，但必须结合当地平衡含水率、用途与干燥记录核: Most indoor woodwork targets about 6–12%, but confirm against local equilibrium moisture, end use and drying records; one reading cannot prove kiln drying. Above the indoor range, dry further before indoor use.
map.纤维饱和点（FSP）是细胞壁吸饱水、胞腔游离水刚排尽的临界点，常见约 25–35: The fibre saturation point (FSP) is where cell walls are saturated and free water has just drained from the cavities, commonly about 25–35%. Below it wood shrinks noticeably; this tool allows 20–40% by species and estimates shrinkage as (FSP − current moisture) ÷ FSP × species coefficient.
map.为什么干燥到目标还要再算一次收缩？: Why calculate shrinkage again when drying to a target?
map.页面先算从 FSP 到当前含水率的累计收缩；填目标含水率后，再算从当前继续干到目: The page first gives cumulative shrinkage from FSP to the current moisture; with a target it then gives the further shrinkage from current to target, in the same direction and as a difference. This separates "how much has it shrunk" from "how much more will it shrink".
